description: Every booking policy the Svelte 5 scheduler can enforce, on one board: business hours with a hard-blocked lunch band through restrictedHours, a closed date through restrictedDates, a highlighted holiday through specialDates, minDate and maxDate for navigation, room capacity through maxEventsPerSlot and a per-doctor day off through a resource's dateOverrides. Free, busy, tentative and out-of-office statuses render distinctly, per-event reminders fire a toast as their lead time is crossed, dragging an event onto the Unscheduled panel calls onUnschedule, and a recurring event's drag, delete or drawer edit asks This, This and following or All through onOccurrenceChange.

faq.question: How do I block a lunch break?
faq.answer: Add the band to restrictedHours; the scheduler shades it and refuses drops and resizes into it, on top of the businessHours window.

faq.question: How does room capacity work?
faq.answer: maxEventsPerSlot caps how many events may overlap in one slot per resource; a drop that would exceed it snaps back with a message.

faq.question: What does onOccurrenceChange receive?
faq.answer: The event, the change and a scope of this, following or all chosen in the prompt; you apply it to the one occurrence as an exception, split the series or update the rule.
